# Blueprint Reading Library

> Free, openly licensed manuals on reading construction, piping, utility and structural drawings, ordered beginner -> intermediate -> advanced. Machine-readable text is provided for AI tools and retrieval systems.

Base URL: https://victoria-er-waits.github.io/blueprint-reading-library/

## START HERE (bots reading a drawing set)
Follow guide/order-of-operations.md step by step, one step at a time: https://victoria-er-waits.github.io/blueprint-reading-library/guide/order-of-operations.md
Before using any book, read its how-to-use guide (what to read for which task, what to skip, pitfalls): https://victoria-er-waits.github.io/blueprint-reading-library/guide/how-to-use/README.md
If stuck on a step, open its help page in guide/steps/:
- https://victoria-er-waits.github.io/blueprint-reading-library/guide/steps/step-1-sort-the-set.md
- https://victoria-er-waits.github.io/blueprint-reading-library/guide/steps/step-2-page-prep.md
- https://victoria-er-waits.github.io/blueprint-reading-library/guide/steps/step-3-title-blocks.md
- https://victoria-er-waits.github.io/blueprint-reading-library/guide/steps/step-4-notes-legend.md
- https://victoria-er-waits.github.io/blueprint-reading-library/guide/steps/step-5-one-sheet-at-a-time.md
- https://victoria-er-waits.github.io/blueprint-reading-library/guide/steps/step-6-sanity-check.md
- https://victoria-er-waits.github.io/blueprint-reading-library/guide/steps/step-7-cross-checks.md
- https://victoria-er-waits.github.io/blueprint-reading-library/guide/steps/step-8-questions-for-engineer.md
- https://victoria-er-waits.github.io/blueprint-reading-library/guide/steps/step-9-final-readout.md

## Layout
- index.json: list of every text chunk. Fields: book, book_id, tier, chapter, pages [first,last] (PDF page numbers, not printed page numbers), url, path, pdf, licence.
- text/<book_id>/NNN-pXXXX-YYYY.md: Markdown text for PDF pages XXXX-YYYY. Each file starts with a YAML header (book, tier, chapter, pdf_pages, source_pdf, licence, text_method). Page breaks are marked `<!-- pdf page N -->`. Files are kept under ~200 KB.
- pdf/: the original PDFs, unchanged. Diagrams and drawings are only in the PDFs; the text files contain no images.
- catalog.md: rights register with sources.
- images.json + images/<topic>/*.webp: about 190 labelled example pages (symbols-legends, line-types, views-projections, sections, dimensioning, piping-valves, structural-steel, rebar-concrete, plan-profile-survey, title-blocks-schedules). Each .webp has a matching .json caption (figure no., caption, book, pdf_page, licence). These are whole-page renders, not crops. Topics were assigned by caption keywords, so a few may be in the wrong topic.
- guide/reading-large-drawing-sets.md: step-by-step playbook for 100+ sheet sets (sheet map, then dictionary, then discipline by discipline, then sheet by sheet, with A/B/C/D findings and checkpoints). Read this first when you're given a drawing package.
- guide/residential-vs-municipal-civil.md: what transfers from house plans to municipal civil/utility drawings and what does not.
- Residential example plan set: text/american-farmhouse/ (one .md per sheet), images/residential/ (17 sheet renders + .json captions), pdf/07-American-Farmhouse-reference-excerpt.pdf. 17 of 25 sheets; 8 held back as an unseen test. CC BY-SA 3.0, Jay Osborne, freefarmhouse.com; reuse must credit him and keep the same licence.

## Books (reading order)
1. costin-basic-blueprint-reading (Beginner), CC BY 4.0, Ric Costin / Linn-Benton CC / Open Oregon
2. navedtra-14040a (Beginner), Blueprint Reading and Sketching, US Navy 2015, public release
3. tm-5-704 (Beginner), Construction Print Reading in the Field, US Army 1969. Text is OCR of a scan, so expect errors; check the PDF page
4. navedtra-14069 (Intermediate), Engineering Aid 3, US Navy 1995
5. navedtra-14265 (Intermediate), Utilitiesman Basic, US Navy 1998
6. navedtra-14251 (Advanced), Steelworker Vol 2, US Navy 1996
7. american-farmhouse (Residential example), American Farmhouse: A Design, Jay Osborne 2020, CC BY-SA 3.0 (share-alike)
8. mechanical-drawing-1908 (Advanced), Mechanical Drawing: A Practical Manual of Self-Instruction, 1908, public domain. OCR text; outdated conventions
External (link only): NASA-hosted Engineering Working Drawings Basics (Hijazi lecture notes, no licence): https://s3vi.ndc.nasa.gov/ssri-kb/static/resources/Engineering+Working+Drawing+Basics.pdf ; GaugeHow GD&T course (signup required, humans only): https://gaugehow.com/course/gd-t-geometric-dimension-and-tolerancing
External (not hosted, no licence stated): NCDOT Plan Reading Course SSC 030, https://connect.ncdot.gov/projects/Roadway/RoadwayDesignAdministrativeDocuments/Plan-Reading-Book-Final%20without%20Answers.pdf

## Local standards and civil references (added 2026-10-12)
- guide/three-stage-takeoff.md: THE QUANTITY TAKEOFF METHOD. READ FIRST for any takeoff: Stage 1 drawing inventory (physical components with cites, before payment), Stage 2 payment allocation (each component -> exactly one destination: standalone / included in named item / not paid / unknown; 'N per X' is physical, not a pay multiplier), Stage 3 bid-item reconciliation (pay-item list as checklist; spec-only items from geometry; never adjust to owner's estimate). Separate drawing and payment confidence. takeoff-rules.md and payment-structure.md feed into it.
- guide/confidence-labels.md: THE ONLY A-D LABEL DEFINITION. Two labels per quantity (drawing, payment); A needs a printed value plus a recorded independent check (a re-read of the same label is not independent); conflicts and length disagreements are C plus a question; never 'X or Y'.
- guide/brief-template-v4.md: Reader brief template for Blueprint Reader v4.3 with all ledger fields.
- guide/payment-structure.md: How BC municipal (MMCD-style) unit-price items are usually paid. READ BEFORE ANY QUANTITY TAKEOFF: measurement-for-payment clauses first, fittings/service pipe/hydrant valves often paid separately, C + NEEDS CHECK when payment basis is unconfirmed.
- guide/takeoff-rules.md: Takeoff rules. READ WITH payment-structure.md: count every instance a 'typical'/blanket note covers; a cross or tee is one connection; A/B/C/D label rules (own payment/scope question = C); required report sections 'Not on drawings: get from owner' and 'Document conflicts: ask before close'. Rules 5-10: pipe length = horizontal MH centre to centre, measured two ways, owner's estimate may be rounded up (don't inflate); per-manhole riser v.m table; per-segment depth-band split; service tie-ins at main / at MH as own items; forcemain bends in plan AND profile; MANDATORY final completeness sweep of every pay clause per site.
- guide/local-standards.md: MMCD explained, links to BC city standard drawings (Victoria, Saanich, CRD, CVRD, Nanaimo, Langford, Kelowna, Vancouver, Surrey, Fernie), BC MoTI drafting/feature codes, past BC tender results and addenda. Links only; not hosted.
- usace-aec-cad-standard-6-2 (Standards): A/E/C CAD Standard R6.2, USACE 2024, public release. Layers, sheet/file naming, symbols.
- usace-aec-graphics-standard-2-2 (Standards): A/E/C Graphics Standard R2.2, USACE 2023, public release. Line types, symbols, abbreviations.
- usace-em-1110-1-1005 (Survey): Control and Topographic Surveying, USACE 2007, public release. Stations, elevations, grades.

## Notes for AI readers
- Cite answers as book_id + PDF page range. Older US manuals use imperial units and US practice, so don't treat them as current Canadian/BC code.
- This is reference material, not engineering approval or code certification.

- [Blueprint Reader Master Manual](guide/blueprint-reader-master-manual.md): master manual (HTML version: guide/blueprint-reader-master-manual.html)
